events.label: SKHYV when-issued trading begins (SK Hynix ADR, IPO price $149); DAL Q2 earnings (pre-market)
events.note: Two July 10 clearing events: (1) SKHYV when-issued trading — first public market test of SK Hynix ADR at $149 IPO price. Evaluation thresholds: >$162 (+9%) = constructive demand signal, enter SKHY 50% allocation for Monday; >$175 (+17%) = strong demand confirmed, full allocation; <$149 = demand miss in public market. 7x oversubscribed, $26.5B raised (record foreign IPO). Cornerstone investors include Baillie Gifford, Coatue, Situational Awareness Partners ($7B combined). MSCI World inclusion clock starts July 13. (2) DAL Q2 earnings — first major airline read with WTI at $71.74 (-2.42% July 9); a beat with raised guidance = travel demand resilient and oil tailwind acknowledged; a miss = growth scare bleeding into premium consumer spending.

events.label: SKHY regular trading begins on Nasdaq — SK Hynix ADR full debut; MSCI World inclusion clock starts
events.note: SK Hynix ($28B offering, 7x oversubscribed, priced at $149/ADS on July 9) begins regular Nasdaq trading under SKHY on July 13 (after when-issued SKHYV session July 10). MSCI World inclusion eligibility clock starts at listing — typically 2-3 quarters to achieve inclusion, triggering passive inflows. Opening price vs. $149 IPO and subsequent session trajectory defines the institutional AI memory demand premium. Full entry activated if SKHY sustains above $162 through first week of trading.

events.label: June CPI release (8:30 AM ET) — Cleveland Fed nowcast ~3.96% YoY; FOMC September hike 68.8%
events.note: June CPI is the summer's regime-defining binary. Context: May CPI 4.2%; Cleveland Fed June nowcast ~3.96% YoY (directional disinflation); FOMC September hike probability 68.8% (from minutes July 8); WTI averaged $71-74 in June (Brent $75-78); ISM Prices Paid fell to 73.0 from 82.1. Scenario A: CPI ≤3.5% → September hike probability collapses; 30Y retreats below 5.00%; BUY upgrades to HIGH conviction; full NVDA/AVGO/SKHY adds activated. Scenario B: CPI ≥4.0% → September hike becomes base case; STEP ASIDE/BEARISH warranted; TLT short target achieved. Scenario C: 3.5-4.0% → maintain MEDIUM HOLD into July 28 FOMC. Do not add gross exposure before the print.

events.label: TSLA Q2 2026 earnings (est.) — after market close; 480K delivery beat sets the floor
events.note: Q2 earnings follow the July 2 delivery report: 480,126 vehicles delivered (vs. 406,024 consensus; +25% YoY; best-ever Q2). Despite the blowout beat, TSLA fell ~7.49% on July 2 (sell-the-news + growth scare). Q2 earnings call (~July 22) is the fundamental clearing event: need gross margin recovery (>25%), FSD revenue recognition at scale, and Q3 delivery guide >450K for the stock to re-rate above $420. Weak gross margin (<22%) or no FSD clarity = $393 July 2 close is the near-term top.

events.label: FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — July hike probability ~20%; September hike 68.8%; June CPI (Jul 14) is the determining input
events.note: July 28 FOMC hike probability ~19-20% (no change expected at July meeting). June 17 FOMC minutes (released July 8) confirmed: no cuts until Q2 2027; September hike probability 68.8%; December 85.3%. The June CPI release (July 14) is the primary input — CPI ≤3.5% would collapse September hike probability; CPI ≥4.0% would confirm September hike as base case. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — Warsh can move in either direction without political pressure.

events.label: META Q2 2026 earnings — AI cloud business first quantification; earnings season peak week
events.note: META Q2 earnings July 29 is the first event where management must quantify the cloud business (Bloomberg July 1: Meta building AI cloud to sell excess compute). META +2.98% on July 6 on rate-relief bid. Q2 earnings is the first AI-at-scale quarter. GOOGL, MSFT, and AMZN also report in mid-to-late July — peak Q2 earnings risk window. ISM Services 54.0% (July 6) validates the Search and Cloud AI expansion narrative.

events.label: Iran-US ceasefire 60-day deadline (original Islamabad Declaration) — now voided; Iran conflict ongoing Day 2+
events.note: The original Islamabad MOU signed June 18 set a 60-day window expiring August 13. That framework was declared 'over' by Trump on July 8 after Iran-IRGC struck US military targets. US-Iran entered Day 2 of kinetic exchange on July 9 (US struck 90 Iranian targets; Iran retaliated in Kuwait and Bahrain). WTI fell 2.42% to $71.74 on July 9 despite the escalation — market pricing no Hormuz closure. Any back-channel ceasefire reopening would sharply reverse energy sector and rebuild the dual-gate buffer. Watch IRGC/Hormuz shipping data for tanker disruption signals.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — $91B revenue guide; AI capex cycle fundamental clearing event
events.note: NVDA's Q2 FY27 earnings is the fundamental clearing event for the AI capex thesis. $91B revenue guidance represents sequential acceleration. NVDA closed ~$201.69 July 9 (four-gate triggered at open; one close above $200; full-size after 2nd consecutive close >$200). China H200 approval (<200K chips, training-only) extends NVDA training moat; inference displacement risk from DeepSeek remains. Stop: close below $195. Full-size add gate: NVDA 2 consecutive closes above $200 + SPX >7,460 + VIX <17. August 26 earnings remains the ultimate fundamental clearing event for the $91B guide.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since June 12 IPO. SPCX Nasdaq-100 effective July 7; inclusion-day distribution confirmed at $158.77 peak. Re-entry gate: two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn) is the fundamental clearing event after the inclusion-day distribution pattern. Lock-up expiry December 9 adds supply overhang.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. The $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds equity supply overhang.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst and adds uncertainty to AI infrastructure spending trajectories.
